label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Christmas breakfast Dec 19 - drivers

Hi Rhonda, its Gary from the bus garage again. Hope things are going good with you.

We want to do the drivers christmas breakfast at your place again like every year. Saturday Dec 19, back room, 7am, same as always. If the 19th is no good for you then Dec 12 would work, either one is fine, just let me know which one you want.

Dwayne sent me the list he took off the board in the drivers room. 19 drivers, 3 from the shop, and Earl plus his wife, so 24 all together counting Earl and Carol. Is that the same number you are working with on your end?

Money wise, $11 a head was fair last year. If its up a little thats fine, just let me know the new number so I can pass it along and nobody shows up with the wrong amount. Meats off the menu same as we did before.

A couple of other things.

Patsy cant do eggs, oatmeal or pancakes or whatever else she has got, so she needs something else. What can you do for her that is not eggs? She would eat anything else you have.

Lonnie is on a walker now since his hip, so he needs to come in the side door with no steps. Is that door unlocked at 7am or does somebody need to open it up for us?

Coffee. Last year we ran out about 8:15 when the urn quit. Dont feel bad about that, it was not your fault and nobody blamed you. Could we plan on a backup pot this year, maybe one of the regular ones with a hot plate, so we are covered if the urn goes out again? I know that is asking you to do more work and if there is a better way to handle it just tell me what works for you.

For the cake, I know your cinnamon rolls are better than any cake there is and Earl loves them. Can we bring a cake in from Sugarcreek Bakery, they quoted me $56 for a half sheet with writing and a little bus on top, pickup only and they open at 6am Saturdays. Or would you rather do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls with a candle on it? Whatever is easier on you is fine, I just did not want to mess with your kitchen.

Also we would like separate checks again like last year.

One more thing. Earls last day driving is the 18th, the day before, and a few of us want to do a little something for him on the 19th. He does not know a thing about it so please keep that between us, and if you can keep him out of the back room til everybody is in and settled that would help a lot.

I will get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you asked so you are not wasting food.

Thanks Rhonda, talk soon.

Gary Hollins

reasons: The email never says Earl is retiring and leaves out his 31 years of driving; it only gives the 18th as his last driving day, so the retirement-surprise point is only hinted at.
